Career and business astrology

Discuss a job change, a stalled career or a business decision with an astrologer who reads charts for exactly this.

How it works

What to expect

The houses that matter
The tenth house for profession, the sixth for service and work, the second and eleventh for income.
Timing and dashas
Which period you are running, and what the tradition associates with it for work and money.
A specific question
Bring the actual decision — a move, an offer, a partnership — rather than a general reading.

What a career consultation looks at

An online career astrology consultation reads the parts of your chart traditionally associated with work: the tenth house and its lord, the sixth house, the position of Saturn, and the dasha period you are currently running. A business astrology consultation adds the houses associated with partnership and gain.

The useful version of this conversation is specific. "Should I take this offer", "my business has been flat for two years", "is this the year to go independent" — a chart can be read against a concrete question in a way it cannot be read against "tell me about my career".

What it is and is not

Astrology is one input among several, and a consultation here is not financial, legal or investment advice. An astrologer can tell you what the tradition associates with a period or a placement. The decision, and the due diligence behind it, stays yours — and any consultant who tells you otherwise is overselling.

Frequently asked

Career & Business questions

Can an astrologer tell me whether to take a job offer?

They can tell you what your chart and current period traditionally indicate for a change of work, and talk through the timing. The decision remains yours and should also rest on the practical facts of the offer.

Is this useful for business as well as employment?

Yes. Business questions bring in the houses associated with partnership, investment and gain, and several astrologers on Astrowani work specifically on business charts.

Do I need my birth time for a career reading?

It helps a great deal, because the tenth house depends on the ascendant. Without a reliable birth time an astrologer can still read the planetary positions, and will tell you which conclusions become weaker.

Weighing up a move?

Find an astrologer who works on career and business charts, and talk it through.
